offences.quote: Presenting AI-generated work as your own may constitute plagiarism because you are claiming authorship of content that you did not create yourself.
Failure to reference AI correctly can result in academic misconduct penalties.

detection.quote: They can be used as evidence if you need to show that the work is your own, so make sure you keep a copy of different versions of your assignment.
